tasks.name: Summary
tasks.description: Summary

tasks.name: Q1
tasks.description: 1. I can explain my thoughts and choices.

tasks.name: Q2
tasks.description: 2. I can reflect on useful experiences that have helped me in my learning.

tasks.name: Q3
tasks.description: 3. I can explain how a situation is different from before.

tasks.name: Q4
tasks.description: 4. I know that other people can have perspectives that are different from me.

tasks.name: Q5
tasks.description: 5. I can come up with different ideas by using the ones that I already know or learnt from other people.

tasks.name: Q6
tasks.description: 6. I can explain why the idea that I chose is better than other ideas.

tasks.name: Q7
tasks.description: 7. I can share information and ideas in a way that is suitable for my audience.

tasks.name: Q8
tasks.description: 8. I can listen carefully to others so that I know what they are thinking and feeling, even if their ideas are different from mine.

tasks.name: Q9
tasks.description: 9. I can work well with my group to meet our goals.

tasks.name: Q10
tasks.description: 10. I know what I need to do in my group and I can do them with little help from my group mates.

tasks.name: Q11
tasks.description: 11. I can find information that is helpful to what I am trying to do.

tasks.name: Q12
tasks.description: 12. I can share information in a respectful way.

tasks.name: Q13
tasks.description: 13. I know the national symbols of Singapore and the values they represent.

tasks.name: Q14
tasks.description: 14. I know the issues that affect us in Singapore.

tasks.name: Q15
tasks.description: 15. I have participated actively in my school's community programmes and learnt more about the needs of others.

tasks.name: Q16
tasks.description: 16. I know about the cultural and environmental issues that affect Singapore and other countries.

tasks.name: Q17
tasks.description: 17. I am interested to learn what others think about the issues around the world.

tasks.name: Q18
tasks.description: 18. I know about the traditions and practices of my culture.

tasks.name: Q19
tasks.description: 19. I am respectful to people who have different beliefs, traditions and practices from me.
